findings.title: Torn write permanently kills chain writer AND all ledger readers
findings.detail: A crash mid-append leaves a partial JSON line; _chain_append reads the last line for prev_hash and raises JSONDecodeError forever after; every ledger reader (births, decisions, scoreboard) also crashes. The forward archive would go down and STAY down until manual repair. Reproduced.
findings.impact: archive availability; no false evidence created

findings.title: Single symbol can dominate analogue support (status=OK from 50 same-symbol rows)
findings.detail: AnalogResult support uses n_effective (sessions) and distance only; 50 AMD rows across 25 sessions -> OK. A wrongly-confident OK suppresses the capital analog_support_low caution factor (x0.75), i.e. an ANTI-CONSERVATIVE channel. Directive explicitly requires one-stock/one-day non-dominance.
findings.impact: monotone caution violated via defective support quality

findings.title: Frozen protocol section 2 promises 'regime' in STATE records; actual records lack it
findings.detail: HUNTER-FORWARD-PROTOCOL.md (hash bf4db439) says state records include 'regime (daily online classifier + intraday vol state)'. hunter_forward_clock state records contain neither. DOCUMENTED_BUT_MISSING in the frozen law itself.
findings.impact: protocol/reality mismatch discovered before first record; additive repair legal

findings.title: Simulator fabricates atr_frac=0.02 when unknown (atr_frac or 0.02)
findings.detail: Unknown vol scale silently becomes 2%, distorting branch classification of a diagnostic tool. Unknown must remain unknown (refuse).
findings.impact: diagnostic-only today, but violates the fail-closed law

findings.title: ML dataset builder coerces up to 4 missing features to scaled-zero (nan_to_num)
findings.detail: Missing feature -> 0.0 in scaled units, which reads as 'typical'. Model UNTRAINED today; the defect would activate exactly when training begins.

findings.title: memory.analog_memory_rows regime derivation returns 0.0 on a flat market
findings.detail: `x and (...)` idiom: day_return==0.0 is falsy so regime becomes 0.0 (a float) instead of a label/None. Feeds analogue regime_mix.
findings.impact: corrupted regime label in analogue memory rows

findings.title: MIN_PRICE and MIN_MEDIAN_DOLLAR_VOL defined independently in scanner.py AND context_builder.py
findings.detail: The same economic liquidity rule exists in two places (both 5.0 / 50e6 today) and can diverge silently.

findings.title: HOLIDAYS set is empty (fixture-grade, labeled but live)
findings.detail: Labor Day 2026-09-07 would be treated as a trading session: clock fetches, gets nothing, writes unusable-flagged state records (honest degradation, not corruption). Early closes has only 2026-11-27.
findings.impact: noise records + wasted quota on holidays

findings.title: decision_id/candidate ids are uuid4 -> identical inputs produce different ledger records
findings.detail: Found via future-poison probe (only divergence was uuids). Content-derived ids would make the pass replayable bit-for-bit.

findings.title: Mutation 'analog formed-at firewall removed' survived the suite
findings.detail: The resolved-at check shadows the formed-at check for honest data; no test isolates a row formed after as_of with resolved_at before as_of (adversarial shape). 7/8 other guard mutations were caught.
findings.impact: single-mutation tolerance in a critical firewall

findings.title: TradeThesis is not constructed by paper authorization; trade-management law duplicated
findings.detail: authorize_paper builds PaperOrder without an immutable TradeThesis (lineage law requires one per authorized opportunity); paper.manage re-implements stop/partial law instead of wrapping the sealed TradeLifecycle state machine (two management laws). Production impact zero today (PAPER_ELIGIBLE unreachable).
findings.impact: Phase-5 lineage completeness + duplicate source of truth

findings.title: Causal layer is ornamental for Hunter: mechanism_status hardcoded 'ASSOCIATIONAL'
findings.detail: apex/causal exists and is governed, but forecast.py never consults it; the constant is honest for v1 playbooks yet the layer contributes no decision effect.

findings.title: AnalogResult field 'p_positive' names an empirical frequency
findings.detail: Value is an uncalibrated frequency; calibration_status says UNCALIBRATED but the name suggests probability (false-confidence surface).
findings.impact: semantic leakage risk in future displays

findings.title: No lock file: a manual clock run can interleave with the launchd tick
findings.detail: launchd itself never double-launches, but an operator/dev manual run during session hours could interleave ledger appends.

findings.title: Zero-decision days produce no scoreboard artifact (POST tick early-returns)
findings.detail: Health/scoreboard can always be run manually; automatic EOD artifact skips empty days.

findings.title: GAP_AND_GO fires all session for any persistent 2 percent gap
findings.detail: Attention signal re-fires each tick while direction persists; dedup happens at decision level, watchlist may stay occupied.
findings.impact: attention-budget noise, recorded as finding NOT retuned

findings.title: Opening range anchors to first VISIBLE bar; late-starting data mislabels OR window
findings.detail: If bars begin 09:45, the 'opening range' is 09:45-10:15. SPARSE_BARS quality flag fires at >20 percent missing, partially covering.
findings.impact: feature mislabeling under vendor data gaps
